title: Best Nature Destinations in India: Forests, Valleys, Waterfalls and Lakes
excerpt: A guide to the best nature destinations in India, organised by landscape rather than by town: Himalayan valleys and high lakes, Western Ghats forests and waterfalls, the root bridges, caves and river valleys of the Northeast, lagoons and mangroves on the coasts, and geological wonders such as Gandikota and the Rann of Kutch, with the best season for each and how to choose.
imageAlt: A Dzukou lily in flower in the Dzukou valley on the Nagaland–Manipur border

title: Natural Wonders of India: Canyons, Craters, Root Bridges and More
excerpt: A guide to the natural wonders of India: the Gandikota gorge on the Penna, the Marble Rocks and Dhuandhar Falls at Bhedaghat, the Lonar crater lake, Meghalaya's living root bridges and Laitlum canyons, the white salt desert of the Rann of Kutch, Loktak Lake's floating islands, the basalt columns of St Mary's Islands, Baratang's mud volcanoes, and the caves of Borra and Belum, with how and when to visit.
imageAlt: The Penna river gorge at Gandikota at sunset, Andhra Pradesh

title: Forest Destinations in India: Rainforests, Sal Forests, Mangroves and Forest Stays
excerpt: A guide to forest destinations in India by forest type: tropical evergreen rainforests of the Western Ghats and Northeast (Silent Valley, Agumbe, Namdapha), moist deciduous sal forests (Similipal, Saranda, Kanha), mangroves (Sundarbans, Bhitarkanika), Himalayan oak, deodar and rhododendron forests, dry forests, and sacred groves such as Mawphlang, with forest stays, seasons and how forests differ from wildlife reserves.
imageAlt: Evergreen forest on the hills of Silent Valley National Park, Kerala

title: Himalayan Nature Travel: Alpine Meadows, Glacial Lakes, Forests and Valleys
excerpt: A guide to Himalayan nature travel in India: the ecological zones from sub-tropical foothills to alpine meadows and cold desert, the UNESCO natural sites of Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers, the Great Himalayan National Park and Khangchendzonga, glacial lakes, bugyals (high meadows), rhododendron forests and river valleys, with seasons, altitude and how nature trips differ from hill-station holidays.
imageAlt: Chandratal lake below the peaks of the Spiti region, Himachal Pradesh

title: Most Beautiful Valleys in India: Himalayan, Northeastern and Southern Valleys
excerpt: A guide to the most beautiful valleys in India: Himalayan valleys (Valley of Flowers, Spiti, Kinnaur's Sangla, Parvati, Tirthan, Kashmir's Gurez and Lidder), eastern Himalayan valleys (Yumthang, Dzongu, Mechuka), northeastern highland valleys (Dzukou, Ziro), and southern valleys (Araku, Silent Valley, Kanger Valley), with the best season, access and permits.
imageAlt: Clouds over the Yumthang valley in North Sikkim

title: Waterfalls in India: The Best Falls by Region and When to See Them
excerpt: A guide to the best waterfalls in India by region: Karnataka's Jog and Abbey Falls, Dudhsagar on the Goa border, Kerala's Athirappilly, Tamil Nadu's Hogenakkal and Courtallam, Meghalaya's Nohkalikai, Seven Sisters and Krang Suri, Chhattisgarh's Chitrakote and Tirathgarh, Jharkhand's Hundru, Madhya Pradesh's Dhuandhar and Mizoram's Vantawng, with the best season, access and monsoon safety.
imageAlt: Jog Falls on the Sharavathi river in full monsoon flow, Karnataka

title: Lakes in India: High-Altitude Lakes, Lagoons and Wetlands
excerpt: A guide to the best lakes in India by type: high-altitude lakes in Ladakh, Sikkim and Himachal (Pangong, Tso Moriri, Chandratal, Gurudongmar, Tsomgo, Prashar), valley and hill lakes (Dal, Loktak, Umiam, Naini, Khecheopalri), coastal lagoons and backwaters (Chilika, Vembanad), and wetlands recognised under the Ramsar Convention, with seasons, permits and responsible travel.
imageAlt: The shore of Pangong Tso in Ladakh

title: Riverside Destinations in India: River Valleys, Islands and Backwaters
excerpt: A guide to riverside nature destinations in India: Himalayan river valleys such as the Beas at Tirthan and Kasol, the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda, and the Teesta; the Brahmaputra and Majuli river island; Dawki's clear Umngot; the Kaveri at Hogenakkal and Coorg; Hampi on the Tungabhadra; the Narmada at Bhedaghat; and the Kerala backwaters, with river stays, seasons and water safety.
imageAlt: A ferry on the Brahmaputra at Majuli, Assam

title: Natural Caves in India: Limestone Caves, Sea Caves and How to Visit
excerpt: A guide to natural caves in India for travellers: the limestone caves of Borra in the Araku hills and Belum near Kurnool, Meghalaya's show cave at Mawsmai and its long cave systems for experienced cavers, Kotumsar in Chhattisgarh's Kanger Valley, Tharon in Arunachal, Naida's sandstone caves near Diu and Baratang's limestone caves in the Andamans, with how natural caves differ from rock-cut ones and cave safety.
imageAlt: Stalactite formations inside the Borra Caves, Araku valley, Andhra Pradesh

title: The Western Ghats: A Nature Traveller's Guide
excerpt: A guide to the Western Ghats for nature travellers: the range and its UNESCO World Heritage status, shola grasslands, rainforests and waterfalls, the Kaas plateau, and the best places to experience them state by state (Maharashtra's Sahyadri, Goa's Mollem, Karnataka's Agumbe, Kudremukh and Coorg, Kerala's Silent Valley, Wayanad and Munnar, and Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris and Anamalais), with the monsoon and the best seasons.
imageAlt: Shola grasslands and forest in Kudremukh National Park, Karnataka

title: Nature Travel in Northeast India: Forests, Rivers, Caves and Valleys
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Northeast India: Meghalaya's plateau of waterfalls, caves and living root bridges; Arunachal's Ziro, Mechuka, Dibang and Namdapha; Assam's Brahmaputra and Majuli; Nagaland's Dzukou; Manipur's Loktak and Shirui; Mizoram's Phawngpui and Vantawng; Tripura's Jampui and Unakoti; and Sikkim's lakes and rhododendron valleys, with permits, seasons and community-led travel.
imageAlt: The double-decker living root bridge at Nongriat, Meghalaya

title: Nature Travel in Kerala
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Kerala: the rainforest of Silent Valley, the shola grasslands of Eravikulam, Athirappilly and Vazhachal falls, Periyar lake at Thekkady, the forests and peaks of Wayanad, the meadows of Vagamon, and the backwaters of Vembanad, Kumarakom and Munroe Island, with the best seasons and how to plan a trip.
imageAlt: Athirappilly Falls on the Chalakudy river, Thrissur district, Kerala

title: Nature Travel in Karnataka
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Karnataka: the Western Ghats of the Malnad region, with Jog Falls, the rainforest of Agumbe, the grassland of Kudremukh and Kodachadri, the coffee hills of Coorg and Chikmagalur, the Kali river at Dandeli, and the granite boulder landscape of Hampi, with seasons, trek bookings and practical tips.
imageAlt: Grassy slopes of the Kodachadri hills in the Western Ghats, Karnataka

title: Nature Travel in Meghalaya
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Meghalaya: the living root bridges of Nongriat and Mawlynnong, the waterfalls and caves around Sohra (Cherrapunji), the clear Umngot river at Dawki, the Laitlum canyons, the Mawphlang sacred grove, the Jaintia hills' Krang Suri falls and the caves of the Garo hills, with seasons, village fees and practical tips.
imageAlt: A boat on the clear Umngot river at Dawki, Meghalaya

title: Nature Travel in Uttarakhand
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Uttarakhand: the Valley of Flowers and Nanda Devi landscape, high meadows at Chopta, Auli and Dayara, Kumaon's oak and rhododendron forests at Binsar and Munsiyari, the Nainital lake district, the Ganga and Alaknanda valleys, and the terai forests, with seasons, permits and safety.
imageAlt: The Valley of Flowers below snow-streaked peaks, Uttarakhand

title: Nature Travel in Himachal Pradesh
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Himachal Pradesh: the Great Himalayan National Park and the Tirthan and Jibhi valleys, Prashar Lake, Chandratal and the cold desert of Spiti and Pin Valley, Kinnaur's Sangla valley, the Parvati valley, the Dhauladhar above Dharamshala, and the meadows of Khajjiar, with seasons, roads and safety.
imageAlt: Prashar Lake in its grassy bowl above the Mandi hills, Himachal Pradesh

title: Nature Travel in Odisha
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Odisha: Chilika Lake and its birds and dolphins, the mangrove creeks of Bhitarkanika, Simlipal's forests and waterfalls, the Mahanadi's Satkosia gorge, the hill country of Daringbadi and Koraput with Duduma falls and Deomali, and the coast, with seasons and practical tips.
imageAlt: A boat crossing Chilika Lake, Odisha

title: Nature Travel in Madhya Pradesh
excerpt: A guide to nature travel in Madhya Pradesh: the Narmada's marble gorge and Dhuandhar falls at Bhedaghat, Pachmarhi's waterfalls and viewpoints in the Satpura range, the Narmada's source at Amarkantak, the Patalkot valley, Mandu's plateau in the monsoon, and the sal forests of Kanha, Pench, Bandhavgarh and Satpura, with seasons and tips.
imageAlt: The marble rocks of the Narmada gorge at Bhedaghat near Jabalpur

title: Eco Tourism in India: Community-Run Experiences and Responsible Nature Travel
excerpt: A practical guide to eco tourism in India: what the term means, the difference between genuine eco tourism and green marketing, community-run examples such as Khonoma in Nagaland, Mawlynnong in Meghalaya, homestays in Ladakh and Sarmoli near Munsiyari, forest-department eco tourism at Periyar and elsewhere, Kerala's responsible tourism approach, and how to travel with a lighter footprint.
imageAlt: A traditional stilt house in Mawlynnong village, Meghalaya

title: Biodiversity Hotspots in India: The Himalaya, Indo-Burma, Western Ghats and Sundaland
excerpt: A travel-focused guide to biodiversity in India: the four global biodiversity hotspots that overlap India (the Himalaya, Indo-Burma, the Western Ghats and Sri Lanka, and Sundaland in the Nicobar Islands), biosphere reserves, marine biodiversity in the Gulf of Mannar, Andaman and Lakshadweep, butterflies and endemic species, and where visitors can experience them responsibly.
imageAlt: Shola grassland and forest patches on a Western Ghats ridge

title: Flower Valleys and Blooms in India: When and Where to See Them
excerpt: A seasonal guide to flower valleys and blooms in India: the Valley of Flowers in Uttarakhand, the Kaas plateau in Maharashtra, rhododendrons in Sikkim's Yumthang and Barsey, the Dzukou lily and Manipur's Shirui lily, Srinagar's tulip garden, Neelakurinji in Kerala, and cherry blossoms in Shillong, with bloom windows, booking and why no bloom can be guaranteed.
imageAlt: Wildflowers on the Kaas plateau in the Sahyadri hills, Maharashtra

title: Nature Retreats in India: Forest Stays, Lakeside and Riverside Retreats
excerpt: A guide to nature retreats in India: the main kinds of stay (forest lodges, plantation bungalows, lakeside and backwater retreats, riverside camps, mountain homestays and forest department rest houses), the best regions for each, how budget and luxury retreats differ, how to judge an eco-claim, and when to go.
imageAlt: Forested ghats of Wayanad under monsoon clouds, Kerala

title: Village Tourism in India: Rural Stays in the Himalaya, Northeast and South
excerpt: A guide to village tourism in India for nature travellers: community-run villages in Meghalaya and Nagaland, Ziro's rice valley, Himalayan villages in Kinnaur, Spiti and Ladakh, backwater villages in Kerala, and the UN Tourism Best Tourism Villages at Pochampally and Dhordo, with homestays, etiquette and seasons.
imageAlt: Kalpa village below the Kinner Kailash range, Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh

title: Nature Photography in India: Landscapes, Waterfalls, Forests and Night Skies
excerpt: A guide to nature photography in India: the best places and seasons for mountain and lake landscapes, waterfalls, forests, flower blooms and night skies, when the light is best, gear that copes with rain, dust and altitude, drone rules, and field ethics for photographing people and fragile places.
imageAlt: Tso Moriri and the Changthang grasslands, Ladakh

title: Offbeat Nature Destinations in India: Quieter Forests, Valleys and Lakes
excerpt: A guide to offbeat nature destinations in India: quieter valleys such as Mechuka, Dzongu, Gurez and Tirthan; forests and hills such as Meghamalai, Valparai, Kanger valley and Mainpat; lakes and rivers such as Satkosia and Shnongpdeng; and how to travel responsibly to less-visited places, with permits and seasons.
imageAlt: Rice fields in the Ziro valley, Arunachal Pradesh

title: Best Time for Nature Travel in India: A Month-by-Month Guide
short: Best time for nature travel in India
excerpt: A month-by-month guide to nature travel in India: where to go in winter, spring, summer, the monsoon and autumn for forests, waterfalls, lakes, valleys, flower blooms and clear Himalayan views, with season notes on park closures, pass openings and weather risks.
imageAlt: Dudhsagar Falls on the Mandovi river, Goa

title: Nature Getaways for Couples in India: Quiet Forests, Lakes and Valleys
excerpt: A guide to nature getaways for couples in India: quiet backwaters, forest stays, mountain valleys, lakes and waterfall country, including Kumarakom, Munroe Island, Coorg, Wayanad, Tirthan, Kumaon, Srinagar's Nigeen lake, Meghalaya and West Sikkim, with seasons and tips for a relaxed trip.
imageAlt: Chinar trees reflected in Nigeen Lake, Srinagar

title: Nature Trips for Families in India: Easy Forests, Lakes and Waterfalls
excerpt: A guide to nature trips for families in India: destinations with easy walks, boat rides, waterfalls and forest experiences suitable for children and older relatives, including Thekkady, Munnar, the Kerala backwaters, Coorg, Nainital and Bhimtal, Meghalaya, Pachmarhi and Sikkim, with seasons and family tips.
imageAlt: Periyar Lake at Thekkady, Periyar Tiger Reserve, Kerala

title: How to Plan a Nature Trip in India: Seasons, Days, Costs and Rules
short: How to plan a nature trip in India
excerpt: A practical guide to planning a nature trip in India: choosing the landscape and season, how many days to allow, getting there, permits and forest bookings, where to stay, what drives the cost, tips for first-timers and solo travellers, packing, and staying safe and responsible outdoors.
imageAlt: A footbridge over the Tirthan river, Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh

title: Meghalaya Nature Itinerary: Six Days of Waterfalls, Caves and Root Bridges
excerpt: A six-day nature itinerary for Meghalaya from Guwahati: Umiam lake and Shillong, the Laitlum canyons, Sohra's waterfalls and Mawsmai cave, a night at Nongriat for the double-decker root bridge and Rainbow Falls, Mawlynnong village, and the clear Umngot river at Dawki and Shnongpdeng, with drive times, seasons and variations.
imageAlt: Nohkalikai Falls near Sohra (Cherrapunji), Meghalaya

title: Kerala Nature Itinerary: Hills, Forests, Waterfalls and Backwaters
excerpt: A seven-day nature itinerary for Kerala from Kochi: Athirappilly and Vazhachal falls, two days in Munnar with Eravikulam's grasslands and tea country, Thekkady with Periyar lake and forest walks, and the Vembanad backwaters at Kumarakom or Alappuzha, with drive times, seasons and variations for Wayanad and Vagamon.
imageAlt: A boat on the backwaters at Kumarakom, Kerala

title: Western Ghats Nature Itinerary: Coorg, Chikmagalur, Jog Falls and Dandeli
excerpt: An eight-day nature itinerary through Karnataka's Western Ghats from Bengaluru: Coorg's coffee hills and falls, Chikmagalur's peaks and grasslands, the road through Kudremukh and Agumbe's rainforest, Jog Falls, and the forests and Kali river at Dandeli, ending at Hubballi or Goa, with drive times, seasons and variations.
imageAlt: The Kali river near Dandeli, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka
